who: Three independent LLM annotators (Claude agents), each reading all 30 cases in a different order, without seeing the others; not native speakers.
definitions: Categories (choose all that apply; "lost" also covers information that is changed into something with a different meaning): number: a quantity, count, measurement, percentage or other numeral (e.g. "40", "zehn", "Millionen"). name: a proper name of a person, place, organisation, event, work or title. date: a date, year, time of day, period or duration ("1979", "seit drei Jahren", "im Sommer"). clause: a whole proposition that is gone entirely: an event, action, reason, purpose, condition, consequence, or an item of a list. qualifier: a word or phrase that grades, limits or specifies a claim that is otherwise kept: adjectives, adverbs, hedges, quantifiers, comparatives ("fast", "sehr", "lokal", "insbesondere", "vor allem", "relativ"). other: anything else lost or changed in meaning (e.g. a changed agent or relation, a modality such as "verlangt" becoming "sieht vor", a wrong word). none: nothing from the input is missing or changed in the output (the NLI "dropped" flag is a false alarm). Use "none" only alone.
